tbesh_html:
1) to tear apart or away, tear off, break away
1a) (Qal) to tear away, snatch, rescue
1b) (Piel) to tear off
1c) (Hithpael) to tear off from oneself, be broken off, be broken in pieces
Aramaic equivalent: pe.raq (פְּרַק "to break" H6562)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to break off or crunch; figuratively, to deliver
strongs_1890.kjv_def: break (off), deliver, redeem, rend (in pieces), tear in pieces.
